method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: On first snapshot closes popups, optionally debug-closes old HUDs for reload/migration, removes children and arranges loading closure. In Warzone, loading closes only after wzLoadFinished==1; Close clip completion is tracked before freeing, except splitscreen/immediate path. Creates/tracks cursor/fade/overlay/start menu, calls common setup and selects nonZombie or Zombie setup. Finally refreshes HUD, marks snapshot processed and drains pending menu events in order. Repeated model callbacks and parent validity rely on native lifecycle; no runtime proof is claimed.
unknowns: Exact source-to-original-PS4/build match and decompiler fidelity unverified.
Native LUI/Engine/VM/model ownership, callback delivery/order, cancellation, assets/localization/settings/DDL/storage/network/services and unavailable server code remain unverified where used.

summary.answer: Creates black fade and native crosshair-occluder layers. scriptNotify branches map exact tokens to QuickFade, MediumLengthFade, QuickFadeUp, PostPOTM and InfectionFade clip requests. It installs close and, unusually, optional PreLoadFunc at this late source point; PC or splitscreen-in-game then sizes BlackFade to screen width before return self. Clip definitions and actual notify/render delivery remain separate.
unknowns: No actual callback delivery, cancellation-after-close, successful native mutation or service response is proved.
